name: confirm-pass-check
title: Confirm Password Check
description: A password and confirm-password pair with an eye toggle and a matching check. The confirmation border turns red with a do-not-match note or green when it matches, and an info icon shows the rules.
use: A sign-up form needs to catch typos by making people enter the same password twice.
avoid: It only compares the two strings; it never checks the password against a server or breach list.
a11y: Inputs remove their focus outline, and the rules are only reachable from the hover card. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two labelled password fields stacked on a dark page, each with a rounded border and an eye icon in the first. Borders colour live: grey when empty, green when valid, red for a mismatch, with red helper text under the confirmation field.
behaves: As the password is typed its border shifts through red, orange and green, and the confirmation field compares on each keystroke. A mismatch shows a red outline and message; a match turns both borders green. The eye reveals both fields at once.
customise: The rules, strength colours and messages are hardcoded arrays and config objects near the top; the two inputs and their labels are written in the JSX.
weight: light: Two controlled inputs with border transitions and a small hover card.
